subject: Can session$clientData$url_search change without having the Shiny app be restarted from scratch?

messages.author: a5edeb4fa89b826c
messages.subject: Can session$clientData$url_search change without having the Shiny app be restarted from scratch?
parts: It seems like in all the situations I've found in which session$clientData$url_search changes (such as by modifying the part of the URL after the "?" in the browser or by clicking on a link to the same Shiny app, but a different url_search), the entire Shiny app is re-executed.  Are there any situations in which url_search changes without the Shiny app being re-started?  In other words, are there ways to have url_search change, and then only those reactives that are dependent on url_search are executed, without restarting the whole app from scratch?

messages.author: a5edeb4fa89b826c
messages.subject: Re: Can session$clientData$url_search change without having the Shiny app be restarted from scratch?
parts:
Stated a bit more clearly: 
Can session$clientData$url_search change without starting a new Shiny *session*?

(If not, then why is it a reactive variable?)

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Can session$clientData$url_search change without having the Shiny app be restarted from scratch?
parts: The entire clientData "list" is a reactive values object. Currently it doesn't look to me like the url_search will change, but that might be considered a bug--it's possible to manipulate the URL without the page reloading using JavaScript (see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/History_API) but it doesn't result in changes to url_search right now AFAICT.
